taskObjective: Verify model selection, structured API response metadata, and gateway endpoint routing for BOTH Claude Sonnet 5 and Claude Opus 5 in gemini-cli-claude using deterministic API metadata (x-litellm-model-group header, usageMetadata, and response.modelVersion).
backgroundContext: Relies on deterministic, structured API response metadata provided by the provider and LiteLLM gateway (x-litellm-model-group headers, response.modelVersion, and usageMetadata token counts) to verify model routing for BOTH Claude Sonnet 5 and Claude Opus 5 without system prompt identity steering.

views.name: Claude Sonnet 5 Structured API Response Metadata
assertions: HTTP 200 OK response with non-empty candidates array
usageMetadata contains promptTokenCount, candidatesTokenCount, and totalTokenCount

views.name: Claude Opus 5 Structured API Response Metadata
assertions: HTTP 200 OK response with non-empty candidates array
usageMetadata contains promptTokenCount, candidatesTokenCount, and totalTokenCount

views.name: CLI Model Picker UI Menu Options (Sonnet & Opus)
assertions: ModelDialog renders 'Claude Opus 5' and 'Claude Sonnet 5' directly in top-level options on main view
Selecting 'Claude Sonnet 5' in ModelDialog updates active model to 'claude-sonnet-5'
Selecting 'Claude Opus 5' in ModelDialog updates active model to 'claude-opus-5'

views.name: Gateway Traffic Log Audit (Sonnet & Opus)
assertions: Log records active POST request to /v1beta/models/claude-sonnet-5 with HTTP 200 OK
Log records active POST request to /v1beta/models/claude-opus-5 with HTTP 200 OK
